description: This Java class represents an error encountered during HL7 message processing within the OpenMRS framework. It manages error details including an error message and detailed information, with database persistence annotations and methods to access and modify its fields.

classes.name: HL7InError
classes.description: Represents an error in processing an HL7 message, extending HL7QueueItem with fields for error info and database mapping annotations.

methods.name: getHL7InErrorId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the HL7 in-error record.

methods.name: setHL7InErrorId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the HL7 in-error record.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the error message associated with this HL7 in-error.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Sets the error message associated with this HL7 in-error.

methods.name: getErrorDetails
methods.description: Returns detailed information about the error.

methods.name: setErrorDetails
methods.description: Sets detailed information about the error, throws an exception if length exceeds maximum.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key ID, as per OpenMRS object contract.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key ID, as per OpenMRS object contract.
